name: Street View Perception Scoring (Wuhan)
description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of Wuhan chosen for this template, not the paper's stimuli. Participants score 30 street views from 0 to 100 on six perceptions (safe, lively, beautiful, wealthy, boring, depressing), the human scoring step of the human–machine adversarial scoring framework of Yao et al. (2019, IJGIS) for Chinese cities. Differences from the original study: (1) no machine model suggests scores; (2) 30 images per participant.
author: Yao et al.
